commit_message: GATE-02: identity and persistent advertisement state — atomic persistence + restart tests
scope_completed: Ed25519 verification (verifyAdvertisement with spec/03 §5 checks: signature, identity binding, timestamp, expiry, canonical encoding)
Persistent monotonic peer sequence floors (InMemorySequenceFloorStore with serialize/restore/restart)
Atomic local persistence abstraction (SequenceFloorStore interface — protocol-core, no hosted DB dependency)
VerifiedNodeAdvertisement and AuthenticatedNodeRecordStub as distinct types (reference/advertisement/advertisement.ts + sequence-floor.ts)
No hosted database dependency in reference/ (verified by architecture test #23)
Restart test: expired advertisements never reset sequence floors (test #7 in gate-02-identity-persistence.test.ts)
Bad signature, wrong NodeId binding, replay (duplicate), expiry, sequence rollback all fail (tests #1-5)
commands_run: JSON parse validation for every conformance/vectors/*.json
protocol_adr_references: ADR-0006 (sequence floor persistence — expiration does NOT reset)
known_limitations: GATE-03 is BLOCKED: requires Principal Architect approval of ADR-0016 (3-message transcript-binding handshake) before LINK_UP can be achieved

The InMemorySequenceFloorStore is suitable for tests and single-process reference implementations; production multi-process deployments need the Prisma-backed implementation in src/lib/sharenet/sequence-floor.ts
No reproducible database migrations exist yet (prisma db push is used, not prisma migrate); the schema is a local development substitution (ADR-0001)
